scope: Corollary 6.5 (Campana’s decomposition of the core) of the manuscript “Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Orbifold-and-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b143366cc99615e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, ∆) be as in Corollary 6.4, and set n = dim X. Starting from (X, ∆), successively take the κ-rational quotient r and the Moishezon– Iitaka fibration M of its stable orbifold base. At each iteration choose such compatible represen- tatives and equip the new base with the stable inf-multiplicity orbifold structure of the composite. The composite after at most n iterations is the core, up to bimeromorphic equivalence of fibrations: c(X,∆) = (M ◦ r)n . The positive-dimensional very general stable orbifold fibers of the r-steps have κ+ = −∞, and those of the M-steps have Kodaira dimension zero. In particular, for a special pair this tower ends at a point.
